snippet.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero & Trails to Azure - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The time has come! Experience Crossbell in 4K this exciting collection of The Legend of Heroes games! Featuring both The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero and The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure, this package reintroduces the classic duology in a whole new way!

When Lloyd Bannings is assigned to Crossbell's Special Support Section, he and his new teammates must prove themselves as they fight to overcome injustice in a city gripped by corruption.

For the first time ever, both critically-acclaimed RPGs can support up to 120 FPS. Alternatively, played in 4K resolution! You can also swap between original and upscaled textures.

Crossbell has never looked so good. Purchase today! Available for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2.

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://www.thelegendofheroes.com/crossbell/azure/ and https://www.thelegendofheroes.com/crossbell/zero/ 

#TrailstoAzure #TrailsfromZero
